src/views/BackupsListView.astro: daisyUI `table` primitive on the backup-history table: no Storybook table component exists, and the `.table` class supplies the cell padding the dense run table needs. Per CLAUDE.md §4.2 this is sanctioned daisyUI-direct-in-view (the audit's escape hatch), not a custom component.
src/views/SchemaView.astro: The Schema shell (web-schema-round3-shell): the clustered tab bar uses the daisyUI `tab` primitive inside `tabs tabs-border` cluster containers (icon-carrying buttons — the header-only ui/Tabs.astro carries no content panels, CLAUDE.md §4.2), the chat launcher is a catalog Ghost Button (`btn btn-ghost`), and the shared entity modal uses `modal`/`btn`.
src/views/RestoreView.astro: daisyUI-direct in a view (CLAUDE.md §4.2 second tier): the restore flow uses btn/alert/badge/table/select/input/checkbox/radio/stats/breadcrumbs primitives directly. The per-base picker, staged steps, and outcome panel are a bespoke Pattern composition mirroring the backup-audit tables — not covered by a single Storybook component.
src/views/IntegrationsSetupWizard.astro: daisyUI-direct in a view (CLAUDE.md §4.2 second tier): the Options step's cleanup-schedule block uses a soft-info `alert` and a `select` cutoff control directly — a small informational retention ladder, not a reusable Storybook component.
src/views/SpaceHomeView.astro: daisyUI-direct in a view (CLAUDE.md §4.2 second tier): the two-region Home (primary + sticky status rail) uses alert/btn/badge and a daisyUI `table` for the backup-history + schema previews directly. The status rail, vertical pipeline, and KPI strip are a bespoke dashboard composition — not a single Storybook component.
src/views/schema/BrowseTab.astro: Moved verbatim from the pre-split SchemaView.astro (web-schema-round3-shell §2.1): the Fields visibility `dropdown` + `input`/`checkbox` tree, the `toggle` Include-removed control, and Card-hosted entity tree (shared-schema-docs §4).
The detail panel renders the canonical entity anatomy (badge chips, alert-soft removed notice, capped lists) as innerHTML in the client script — dynamic content, daisyUI classes only.
src/views/schema/RelationshipsTab.astro: Moved verbatim from the pre-split SchemaView.astro (web-relationships-tab): base `select`, Include-removed `toggle`, `input` search, `btn` actions, and relationship groups rendered as innerHTML in the lazy-load client script.
src/views/schema/HealthTab.astro: Moved verbatim from the pre-split SchemaView.astro (web-health-tab): base `select`, Pro+ `btn` controls, and grade/metric/issue `stats`/`table`/`badge` markup rendered as innerHTML in the lazy-load client script.
src/views/schema/ChatTab.astro: Moved verbatim from the pre-split SchemaView.astro (web-chat-tab): thread `menu`, context `select`, composer `textarea`/`btn`, and conversation bubbles rendered as innerHTML in the client script.
src/views/schema/ChangelogTab.astro: daisyUI-direct in a view (CLAUDE.md §4.2 second tier, web-schema-changelog vanilla-in-view decision): base/kind `select`, Include-removed `toggle`, `input` search, and the day-grouped feed rows (`badge` kind chips, breadcrumb, before→after delta, warning line) rendered as innerHTML in the lazy-load client script — same shape as RelationshipsTab/HealthTab.
